question: Professor Narayan Pradhan has been selected for the 31st GD Birla Award as of March 2022 for the Scientific Research for his major contribution in the field of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**material sciences**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Professor Narayan Pradhan** has been selected for the 31st GD Birla Award for Scientific Research.
 
• He has made a major contribution in the field of **material sciences**.
 
• The GD Birla Award for Scientific Research is one of the prestigious awards in India, recognizing outstanding Indian scientists below the age of 50 for their original research contributions.
 
• Professor Pradhan's work has significantly advanced the understanding and application of material sciences, which has broad implications for various industries and technologies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **GD Birla Award** was instituted in 1991 by the K. K. Birla Foundation.
 
• It carries a cash prize of ₹5 lakh, a citation, and a trophy.
 
• The award aims to encourage and recognize scientists who have made significant contributions to their fields and have the potential to impact the future of science and technology in India.
 
• Past recipients of the award include several prominent scientists who have gone on to achieve further recognition and accolades in their respective fields.
